title: reviewed-execution-envelope.v1
description: Pure projection over ordered references to the separately owned approvals for criteria and evidence policy, scope and non-goals, authority and security decisions, public contracts, durable outputs, and accepted risk. Identical ordered inputs produce one fingerprint. The envelope summarizes authority but grants none; it does not replace, merge, or widen any referenced approval. Missing, ambiguous, stale, or conflicting references refuse derivation.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Each source owner approves its fact; schema owners approve projection rules. Unknown versions refuse.

envelope_fingerprint.description: Deterministic fingerprint of the ordered refs object. Identical ordered inputs always produce this same value.

refs.description: Ordered references to the separately owned approvals. Each key names one protected source; its value is the approval reference used to derive the fingerprint.

spec_policy.description: Reference to the current approval for criteria and evidence policy.

scope_and_non_goals.description: Reference to the current approval for scope and non-goals.

authority_and_security.description: Reference to the current approval for authority and security decisions.

public_contracts.description: Reference to the current approval for public contracts.

durable_outputs.description: Reference to the current approval for durable outputs.

accepted_risk.description: Reference to the current approval for accepted risk.
